officeName: Fenwick IT Solutions · Security Operations Center

patch.label: Patch's desk
patch.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: INTRUDER! Oh. You're the new analyst. Hi! I'm Patch. I protect things. Very, very hard.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: My motto: When in doubt, lock it out! Kofi says my motto needs a second line.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Kofi says you check my plans before I act. That's fine. I have SO many plans.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: You're back! While you were gone, I only quarantined one thing. The stapler. It's in my tote. It knows what it did.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: Today's alerts are ready. I haven't locked anyone out yet. I've been very brave.

kofi.label: Kofi, SOC lead
kofi.description: Your lead. Ask him how this works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Welcome to the Security Operations Center, the SOC. I'm Kofi. I lead the team. Lately, I also lead Patch.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Patch spots threats fast. It is not always right. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Each turn, Patch shows you its plans. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When you tap Approve, Patch does every plan you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Patch is wrong both ways. Sometimes it locks out the boss. Sometimes it closes a real attack.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the shift is only six turns.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Welcome back. Each day I pick alerts for the skills you need most.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Your skills shows your level for each check. They're the same checks the help desk uses.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Review due means a skill is ready for a quick refresh. Short practice, spread over days, helps you remember.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Same job as Friday: Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Escalate if you're not sure. Approve the rest.

board.label: Playbook board
board.description: Kofi's rules, pinned where everyone can see.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A board marked PLAYBOOK. Pinned across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note under them: "Same 3 questions as the help desk. Dana taught me. — Kofi"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in red: POLICY CT-01. Isolating a server? Disabling a leader's account? Check the asset list and the calendar first.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the corner, in robot print: "Question 4: Can we isolate it? — Patch" It is crossed out. Twice.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sign on the coffee machine: ISOLATED BY PATCH. DO NOT RECONNECT.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Patch saw it talking to the internet every 60 seconds. It was checking the time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Under the sign, in neat robot print: "It could have been a spy. A spy that makes coffee. — Patch"

locker.label: Evidence locker
locker.description: Proof goes in. Nothing gets wiped.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A tall locker with a sign: EVIDENCE. Door 3 is sealed with orange tape.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A tag on door 3, in Kofi's writing: "Laptop, case 61140. Legal hold. Do NOT wipe."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kofi's rule, taped to the side: "Copy first. Then we decide."

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Under it, in neat robot print: "I only wanted to clean it a little. — Patch"
